name: linux-time-resync
title: Resync the clock
description: Steps the clock with chrony (chronyc makestep) or restarts systemd-timesyncd, whichever runs here. It does not change the time zone.
measure: if command -v chronyc >/dev/null 2>&1 && chronyc tracking >/dev/null 2>&1; then
arh_plan true "Step the clock with chrony"
arh_blocker "Neither chrony nor systemd-timesyncd runs here"
apply: if command -v chronyc >/dev/null 2>&1 && chronyc tracking >/dev/null 2>&1; then
